views.prompt: Edit this exact SketchUp architectural elevation into a polished photorealistic architectural material rendering. Use-case: architectural visualization, strict geometry preservation. The input is the edit target, not loose inspiration. Preserve exact orthographic elevation camera, full building framing, width/height proportions, roof silhouette and all ridge/hip/valley intersections, window and door counts/locations/sizes, mullions, stairs, wall setbacks, visible basement limits and sloping grade. Do not redesign or add openings, gables, decks, people, cars, trees or bushes. Keep all facades unobstructed. Replace sketch edges and flat shading with realistic material relief, soft daylight, ambient occlusion and realistic subtle reflective glazing (do not mistake see-through opposite-wall artifacts for additional mullions). Use pale blue lightly clouded sky and short natural lawn following exactly the existing grade, with existing driveway rendered as neutral concrete. Materials per ACC MATERIAL PACKAGE EXTERIOR Lot 2: charcoal asphalt shingles; Brickcraft Whitestone white/off-white brick with fine light-gray mortar, matching brick areas in input; Valders Dovewhite Dimensional Splitface limestone, warm dove-white/pale gray subtle cream variation, only in the stone areas shown in input, retain coursing and block scale; white horizontal siding only where siding is shown; white trims and sills; black soffit/fascia roof-edge finish and black gutter finish where present; black window/patio-door frames; black front door; black long-raised garage doors with top glazing exactly as reference. Do not turn brick into siding or stone into brick. Preserve the modeled material placement. Natural neutral midday color, crisp detailed textures without exaggeration, softly shaded reveals, realistic glass, high-end architectural elevation presentation. No text, labels, watermark, border, collage. Landscape 2400x1500 proportions. This is the front elevation; preserve this side exactly.
